name: Gorilla Rami
summary: Gorilla Rami is an exhilarating VR game that builds on the playful mechanics of Gorilla Tag while adding a thrilling, multi-dimensional twist. Players dive into a series of fantastical environments, each designed to push the boundaries of immersive gameplay. In the chilling Horror Maps, you'll navigate through eerie, atmospheric settings filled with unsettling sounds and shadows, demanding both stealth and quick reflexes to avoid the terrifying entities lurking in the darkness.
